meta.title: Enter newline
meta.description: Two composer key configurations: the plugin configuration makes Enter a line break, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter steer and Shift+Enter queue (each rebindable on its own Settings page); the default configuration hot-disables the plugin, hands every key back to DSH and shows what DSH does. Includes an IME-safe replay, one-click restore of the plugin default, and JSON export/import of the saved configuration.
